conbody.p: The drive station causes the conveyor belt to move via the drive pulley (1). A drive unit (2) is connected to the belt conveyor via the drive shaft (3) and is thus able to transfer its rotary movement to the belt conveyor. The drive unit can be optionally equipped with an anti- reversing mechanism. This prevents the drive unit or conveyor belt from running back- wards.

The drive shaft is mounted on two flanged bearings (4) in such a way that it can rotate. A scraper (5) cleans material contaminations from the drive pulley in order to prevent any damage to the conveyor belt.
